v: Ha in Pablo in tik, winhaj Silvano yet' winhaj Timoteo, sko tz'ib'ejb'at jun carta tik t'ayex ex iglesia ex t'a Tesalónica. Yik exxo ko Mam Dios yet' Kajalil Jesucristo. Ayokab' wach'k'olal yet' junk'olal t'a he kal ta'.
Skak' wal yuj diosal t'a Dios eyuuj he masanil. Juntak el tzonh lesalwi, tzex ko nakoti.

Ha t'a yichanh ko Mam Dios sko nakoti to niwan tzex munlaj t'ay, yujto ix eyak' wal och t'a he k'ool. Sko nakoti to tzeyak' serwil Dios chi', yujto te xajan eyuuj. Hanhejtona', tek'an tzeyutej he b'a, yujto anhej Kajal Jesucristo tzeyak'och yipok he k'ool.
Xajanab'il ex yuj Dios, yujto a sik'jinak exxo kaneli.

Ayik kek'nak kalel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il t'ayex, manh tonhejok komon lolonnak onh. Yujto a Yespíritu Dios ochnak ket'ok. Kojtak wal sik'lab'il to te yel jun ab'ix tik. Eyojtak paxi chajtil kutejnak ko b'eyb'al t'a he kal yuj he wach'il.

Ha exxo, ochnak ex ijan he b'eyb'alan ko b'eyb'al chi'. Ix he b'eyb'alan pax sb'eyb'al Kajal Jesús. Wach'chom niwan syaelal ix eyab'i ayik ix he chaan slolonel Dios, palta te tzalajk'olal ix he cha'a, yujto a Yespíritu Dios ix ak'an he tzalajk'olal chi'.
Yuj chi', ix he ch'oxel jun wach' b'eyb'al t'a masanil heb' ketcreyenteal t'a yol yik Macedonia chi' yet' t'a yol yik Acaya tik.

Eyuuj ix pukaxb'at yab'ixal Kajal Jesús t'a junjun lugar. Ix laj yab' heb' aj Macedonia chi' yet' heb' aj Acaya to tzeyak' wal och Dios t'a he k'ool. Manhoknhej heb' ix ab'ani, ix laj yab' pax heb' ay t'a junjun lugar. Yuj chi', manhxo yowalilok a onh skalel eyab'ixal t'a skal heb' anima.

Yujto masanil mach wan yalan eyab'ixal to wach' ajnak onh he chaani ayik kek'nak t'ayex. Wan laj yalanpax heb' chajtil eyutejnak eyaktankan juntzanh eyak'nakoch he diosalok, ix ex och pax ijan eyak'an serwil Dios pitzan, haton jun Dios te yel.

Hanhejtona' syalanpax heb' to wan he tanhwan yemxul Yuninal Dios t'a satcha'anh, haton Jesús. Ha Dios ak'jinakxi pitzwok t'a skal heb' chamnak. Haton tzonh kolankanel t'a yol sk'ab' jun niwan yaelal ol jawok yuj yowal sk'ool Dios.
Eyojtak to manh nab'anhejok ek'nak onh t'ayex.

Ha t'a chonhab' Filipos b'ab'laj ek'nak onh. Eyojtak to niwan yaelal ek' kab'nak ta'. Yak'nak wal chukal heb' t'ayonh. Ayik ko k'ochnak t'a he chonhab' chi', kab'nakxo syaelal chi'. Palta a ko Diosal ochnak ket'ok, yuj chi' maj onh xiw kalanel wach' ab'ix t'a he kal.
Te tojol ek' kutejnak kalan t'ayex. Manh yujok junok tas sko nib'ej tzeyak' t'ayonh, manh yujok to tzex kak' musansatil ek' kalannak el t'ayex.

Icha snib'ej Dios, icha chi' ek' kutejnak kalaneli, yujto ix yil Dios to smoj yak'anoch kopisio kalanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il. Manh yujok sk'echaanh heb' anima ket'ok tzek' kalaneli, palta yik sk'echaanh Dios ket'ok, yujto a tz'ilan ko pensar junjun onh.
Eyojtak, maj onh xit'ek' ex ko montej lolonok. Manh yujok pax kak'an ganar tumin tzek' kalaneli. Ha ko Mam Dios ojtannak to yel skala'.
Maj onh ek' ko say yik tzonh yik'anchaanh heb' anima, manhok ex tik, manhok pax juntzanhxo heb'.
Syal ton kalan t'ayex to yajal onh, yujto schekab' onh Cristo. Palta ina te emnakil ek' kutejnak ko b'a t'ayex. Icha junok ix ix, sya'ilej sk'ib'tzitan yune', icha chi' kutejnak ko b'a t'ayex.
Te xajan ex kuuj. Yuj chi' ko nanak to manhoknhej wach' ab'ix yik Dios tzek' kalel t'ayex, palta ko b'eknak ko b'a kak'an ko k 'inal eyuuj. Icha chi' kutejnak ko b'a ta', yujto te xajanab'il ex kuuj.

Tekan tze nakoti chajtil ek' kutejnak ko munlaj t'a he kal. Kak'nak wal kip ko munlaji. Ayik kek'nak kalel wach' ab'ix yik Dios t'ayex, k'ual t'ak'wal munlajnak onh pax yuj ko gasto. Icha chi' aj kek'nak ta', yujto malaj ko gana ay mach tz'ab'an syail yak'an ko gasto.

Ayik kek'nak ta', te wach' kutejnak ko b'eyb'al. Tojol kutejnak pax ko pensar t'ayex a ex creyente ex ket'ok. Malaj jab'ok chukal ek' ko saynak ta'. Eyojtak to icha chi' ek' kutejnak ko b'a. Hanhejtona' yojtak pax Dios.
Eyojtak to icha syutej sb'a junok winh mamab'il t'a heb' yuninal, icha chi' kutejnak kak'an eyip, kak'anpax sniwanil he k'ool.
Kalannak pax t'ayex to wach' tzeyutej he b'eyb'al icha snib'ej Dios. Ha Dios chi' awtannak onh och t'a yol sk'ab', yik ay kalan kik b'aj ol och Dios yajalil.

Ayik ek' kalannak el slolonel Dios t'a he kal, elanhchamel eyak'nak och t'a he k'ool to yel yik Dios, manh yikok anima. Yuj chi' skak' wal yuj diosal t'a Dios eyuuj. Ha slolonel tik, te yel yiko', ay wal yopisio sb'oan ko pensar a onh creyente onhxo tik.

Lajan ex aj yet' heb' creyente t'a junjun yiglesia Dios t'a yol yik Judea. Ha heb' chi', yikxo Cristo Jesús heb' ket'ok. Ix yab' wal syail heb' yuj heb' yetisraelal. Hanhejtona', ich ex ta', ix eyab' syail yuj heb' eyetchonhab'.

Haton heb' ketisraelal chi' miljinakcham Kajal Jesús icha ajnak smilancham heb' schekab' Dios heb' t'a peka'. Ix onh spechanpaxel heb'. Malaj jab'ok swach'il heb' t'a yichanh Dios. Te ajk'ool syutej sb'a heb' t'a masanil anima.

Ayik skalanel yab'ixal t'a heb' manh israelok yik skolchaj heb', haxo heb' israel max stak'laj heb' kalaneli. Yuj chi' swach' tz'akwiel smul heb' t'a yichanh Dios, haxo tiknaik ix kot lemnaj sk'ak'alk'olal Dios yik slajwiel heb'.
Ex wuk'tak ex wanab', toxonhej ix onh el lemnaj elelal t'a he kal. Wach'chom manhxalaj b'aj skil-laj ko b'a, palta te naan ex kuuj. Sko nib'ej b'at ex kilxi.
Ix kak'lej ko b'ati. Ha in Pablo in tik, tzijtum el ix wak'lej, palta haxo winh Satanás maj onh chaanb'atlaj.
Ayik ol jawok Kajal Jesucristo, haxo ko k'och chi' t'a yichanh, skak'och yipok ko k'ool to eyuuj ol ko cha spak. Eyuuj ol ko cha ko tzalajk'olal. Eyuuj ol ko cha spak ko munlajel, yik ay kelk'ochi.
Eyuuj ay kelk'och t'a yichanh Kajal Jesús chi'. Eyuuj ay pax ko tzalajk'olal.
Yujto maj techaj ex ko naani, yuj chi' ix ko na'a to tzonh kan ko ch'okoj t'a chonhab' Atenas,

yik sko chekanb'at winh kuk'tak Timoteo tik t'ayex, yujto schekab' ko Mam Dios yaj winh. Syalel wach' ab'ix yik Cristo winh ket'ok. Ha winh xit' ak'an he tek'anil, xit' yak'anpax eyip winh, yik tze wach' ak'ejoch Cristo t'a he k'ool.
Ha winh xit' alannak t'ayex, yik wach' malaj ex somchajel he pensar yuj tastak wan eyab'an syail. Yujto eyojtaktaxoni to yowalil sja juntzanh yaelal chi' t'a kib'anh icha snib'ej Dios.
Ayik kek'nak t'ayex, kalnakkani to yowalil skab' syail. Eyojtak, ix elk'och icha tas kalnakkan chi'.

Yujto ix in te kusi ayik ix ex in naankoti, yuj chi' ix in chekb'at winhaj Timoteo tik yab'i tato hanheja' eyak'anoch Cristo t'a he k'ool. Ha wal in naani talaj ix komon juwiel he pensar ta' yuj winh diablo. Tato icha chi', nab'anhej am ix kixtej ko b'a kek' ta'.

Haxo tiknaik ix xit' winhaj Timoteo tik t'ayex. Ixnhej jax winh ix yalan winh to hanheja' tzeyak'och Cristo t'a he k'ool, hanheja' tze xajanej he b'a ta'. Ix yalan winh to tzonh he nakot t'a masanil tiempo, to te xajan onh eyuuj. Ix yalanpax winh to he gana tzonh heyila'. Hanhejtona' ich onh ta', ko gana tzonh b'at ex kila'.
Ha onh tik, tzijtum tas sja t'a kib'anh, wan kab'an syail t'a tik. Palta ayik ix kab'ani to hanheja' tzeyak'och Cristo t'a he k'ool, ix onh te tzalaj eyuuj.
Icha yek'b'at junok chamel t'a kib'anh, icha chi' ix aj ko k'ool kab'ani to tek'an heyaj t'a yik Kajal Jesús.
Eyuuj te ay wal ko tzalajk'olal t'a yichanh ko Mam Dios. Yuj chi' skak' wal yuj diosal t'ay eyuuj, palta a jun yuj diosal skak' chi' max tzak'wan t'a jun tzalajk'olal ix yak' Dios t'ayonh eyuuj.
k'ual t'ak'wal kak'an kip ko lesalwi yik wach' syal ko b'at ex kila' yik ol ko wach' ak'an he tek'anil.
Ko gana to a ko Mam Dios yet' Kajal Jesucristo tz'och ket'ok, yik wach' syal ko b'at ex kila'.
Sko k'an t'a Kajal Jesús, yik ha' ol wach' ak'an he xajanej he b'a. Tze xajanej masanil heb' anima icha skutej ex ko xajanan a onh tik.

Ayik ol jax Kajal Jesucristo, ol onh aj yet'ok a onh yikonhxo tik. Ko gana to a tz'ak'an stek'anil he pensar yik wach' hanheja' wach' he b'eyb'al, malaj jab'ok he paltail t'a yichanh ko Mam Dios t'a jun pekti' chi'.

Ex wuk'tak ex wanab', ek'nak onh kalel t'ayex to wach' tzeyutej he b'eyb'al, yik wach' ol k'echaanh Dios heyet'ok. Haxo tiknaik, tzonh tewib'at t'ayex t'a sb'i Kajal Jesús, cham wal kalanb'ati to tze k'anab'ajej jun cheknab'il tik sik'lab'il.
Eyojtakxo juntzanh scheknab'il Kajal Jesús ek' kalnakkaneli.
Ha juntzanh tas ol walb'at t'ayex tik, snib'ej Dios to ol he k'anab'ajej. Yowalil anhej t'ay skak'och ko pensar: Max yal eyem t'a ajmulal.
Junjun ex ex wuk'tak yowalil tzeyojtakejeli to anhej wal ix eyetb'eyum b'aj tzeyak'och he pensar. Niwanokab' yelk'och ix eyetb'eyum chi' t'ayex junjun ex.
Max yal he nib'anoch junok chukal yet' he niwanil icha heb' manh ojtannakok Dios.
Mokab' eyixtej junok heb' creyente yuj juntzanh tik. Toxo ix cham wal kalan t'ayex to ha Dios Kajal ol ak'an syaelal heb' sk'ulan juntzanh chukal tik.
Yujto a ix onh awtanoch yikok yik wach' skutej ko b'eyb'al. Manh yikok sko k'ulej chukal yuj chi' ix onh yawtej och yikok.
Tato ay heb' schichonoch sk'ool t'a juntzanh cheknab'il tik, manhok t'a junok anima schichonoch sk'ool heb', palta haton t'a Dios ix ak'anoch Yespíritu Santo t'ayonh.
Manh yowalilok a in swalb'at t'ayex to tze xajanej heb' ketcreyenteal, yujto a wal lak'an Dios tz'ak'an he na'a tas tzeyutej he xajanan he b'a.
Ina icha chi' wan eyutan he xajanan masanil heb' ketcreyenteal t'a yol yik Macedonia chi' heyet'ok. Palta ex wuk'tak ex wanab', tzonh tewi wal t'ayex, yik wach' ek'alxo ol he xajanej he b'a.
Tzeyak' wal eyip, yik junk'olal tzex aji. Manh eyaktejkan he b'oan he munlajel. Wach' tzeyutej he munlaj yet' he k'ab', icha ajnak kalankan t'ayex,
yik wach' ay eyelk'och t'a yichanh heb' komon anima. Tato icha chi', k'okb'il syab' he gasto.
Ex wuk'tak ex wanab', ko gana tzeyojtakej wal eli, tas yaj heb' creyente chamnakxo, yik wach' max ex te kus yuj heb', icha skus heb' malaj jab'ok tas ayoch yipok sk'ool.
Ha onhxo tik skak'och t'a ko k'ool to a Jesús ix chami, ix pitzwixi. Icha pax chi' ol aj heb' creyente chamnakxo. Ha Dios ol ak'anxikot heb' yet' Jesús.

Ha juntzanh wan kalanb'at tik t'ayex, haton slolonel Kajal Jesús. Ayik ol jaxok, a onh pitzan onh to tik, manh ol onh b'ab'laj b'atlaj t'a yichanh heb' creyente chamnakxo, junnhej ol aj ko b'at yet' heb'.
Ayik ol kot Kajal Jesús t'a satcha'anh, ol och jun aw te chaanh icha yel yaw jun sat ángel, ol ok' pax k'een strompeta Dios. Haxo heb' creyente chamnakxo ol b'ab'laj pitzwokxi heb'.

Ol lajwok chi', a onhxo pitzan onhto ta' junnhej ol aj kik'jichaanh yet' heb'. Haxo ko b'at chi' t'a skal asun t'a nanhal chaanh, yik b'at ko cha Kajal Jesús chi'. Ichato chi' ol onh aj yet' t'a junelnhej.
Yuj chi', tzeyal-laj eyab' juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al tik, yik ol wach' ja sniwanil he k'ool.
Palta manh yowalilok swalb'at t'ayex b'ak'inh ol jax Kajal Jesús chi'.
Yujto eyojtakxo sik'lab'il to icha junok elk'um sja t'ak'walil, malaj junok mach ojtannak janik' sjawi, icha chi' ol aj sjawi sk'ual sjaub'al Kajal Jesús chi'.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' ol yal heb' anima: Ha onh tik te wach' kaji, ¿tok ay tas sko na'a? xcham heb'. Palta ha t'a jun rato chi' ol lajwok el heb'. Icha tz'aj skot syail yalji yune' junok ix ix, icha chi' ol aj sja yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'. Manh ol kolchajkan el-laj heb' t'a jun yaelal chi'.
Palta a onh tik manh onh ayok ek' t'a k'ik' k'inal, yujto snachajel juntzanh tik kuuj. Yuj chi', wach'chom icha sja junok elk'um ol aj sjawi jun k'ual chi', palta lista skutej ko b'a.
Yujto a onh tik ay onhxo ek' t'a sakil k'inal, yik onhxo k'ualil. Yel manhxo onh ayok ek' t'a k'ik' k'inal, manhxo onh yikok t'ak'walil.
Yuj chi' max yal lajan skutej ko b'a icha juntzanhxo heb' anima ichato waynak, yujto max smaklej heb' sja jun k'ual chi'. Yowalil sko maklej, tek'an pax skutejek ko pensar.
Ha heb' swayi, a t'ak'walil sway heb'. Ha pax heb' tz'uk'an anh, a t'ak'walil syuk' anh heb'.

Palta a onh tik, yik onhxo k'ualil. Yuj chi', tek'an wal skutej ko pensar. Yowalil sko wach' ak'ejoch Cristo t'a ko k'ool. Hanhejtona', yowalil sko xajanej ko b'a, yik lajan ol onh aj yet' heb' soldado skol sb'a yet' k'een k'een syak'och heb' spichulok snhi' sk'ool. Yowalil skak'och yipok ko k'ool to kolb'il onhxo, yik lajan ol onh aj icha heb' soldado k'oxb'il k'een xumpil yuj. Icha chi' skutej ko kolan ko b'a.
Yujto ix onh sik'elta Dios manh yikok syak' ko yaelal yuj yowal sk'ool, palta ix onh sik'elta yik sko cha ko kolnab'il yuj Kajal Jesucristo.
Ha ix cham ko k'exulok, yuj chi' taxonhej pitzan onh mato chamnak onhxo, palta ayik ol jawok, junnhej ol onh aj yet' ko masanil.
Yuj chi', tzeyak'laj he tzalajk'olal junjun ex. Tzeyak'anpax he tek'anil ichataxon wan he k'ulani.

Tzonh tewib'at t'ayex ex wuk'tak yet' ex wanab' yik niwanokab' yelk'och heb' wan smunlaj t'a he kal yuj Kajal Jesús t'a he sat, yujto wan ex skuchb'an heb', wan yekanpax yik Kajal chi' heb' he na'a. Nachajokab'el eyuuj to ha Dios ix ak'an yopisio heb' chi'.
Yowalil niwanokab' yelk'och heb' t'a he sat, tze xajanej heb', yujto smunlaj heb' t'a Kajal Jesús. Te junk'olal slaj eyutej he b'a he masanil ta'.

Scham wal kalanb'at t'ayex to tze chek munlaj heb' malaj snib'ej smunlaji. Tzeyak'anpax sniwanil sk'ool heb' utzin sk'ool. Tzeyak'anpax stek'anil heb' manta wal stek'anil. Niwanokab' tzeyutej he k'ool t'a heb' smasanil.
Ha heb' malaj swach'il syutej sb'a t'ayex, manh he pak he b'a t'a heb'. Wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a t'ayex junjun ex yet' t'a heb' anima smasanil.
Tzalajk'olalokab'nhej eyaji.
Lesalwanhek. Manh eyaktejkan he lesalwi.
Tzeyak' yuj diosal t'a Dios yuj yalnhej tas eyaji, yujto a chi' snib'ej Dios chi' t'ayonh a onh yikonhxo Cristo Jesús tik.
Manh he kachoch waan Yespíritu Dios ayoch t'ayex junjun ex.
Manh eyak'kot eyowal t'a heb' syak' Dios yalel slolonel t'ayex.
Jantaknhej juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al tz'alji t'ayex, cham wal he naani tato yel, mato maay. Ha wal t'a juntzanh yel, hata' tzeyak'och he pensar.
Yalnhej tas malaj swach'il manh he cha'a.

Ha Dios ak'um junk'olal. Ko gana to ha' tzex wach' ik'anoch yikok sik'lab'il. Ko gana pax to ha' stanhwan he pixan, he pensar yet' he niwanil, yik wach' malaj jab'ok he mul ayik ol jawok Kajal Jesucristo.
Ha jun sik'jinak onh eli, tz'elk'och wal tas syala'. Ha ol ak'anelk'och juntzanh tik smasanil.
Ex wuk'tak ex wanab', tzex lesalwi kuuj ta'.
Tzeyak'laj stzatzil he k'ool yuj he xajanan he b'a ta'.
T'a yichanh Kajal Jesús, swalb'at t'ayex to tzeyawtej jun in carta tik t'a skal heb' creyente smasanil ta'.
Aokab' Kajal Jesucristo syak' swach'k'olal t'ayex.
